title: United Baptist Church interior with chimes and organ
description: This photograph shows the new pipe organ installed in the United Baptist Church at a cost of $2,900, with $2,620 in donations pledged toward its purchase 2,620. The tonal section of the organ was placed in the corner of the choir loft, south of the memorial window, while the console was positioned at the centre of the choir loft, behind the pulpit. Casavant organ was dedicated on February 18, 1945. Mass chimes donated by Mrs. McGee in 1951.
